description: This Swift file provides a logging system for an application, including configuration management, custom log handlers with both OSLog and file logging capabilities, label parsing, and metadata handling. It defines enums for log settings and levels, and extensions for logger initialization and message formatting.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: A custom log handler that sends logs to the OSLog subsystem with support for different log levels and metadata merging.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: A custom log handler that writes logs to a file, including metadata, and checks if file logging is enabled.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level setting from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether file logging is enabled via user defaults.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the logging system if it hasn't been set up already.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Creates a label combining subsystem and category with a separator.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label into subsystem and category components.

methods.name: init(subsystem:category:)
methods.description: Initializes an OSLog handler with specified subsystem and category.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Sends a log message with level, message, metadata, and source info.

methods.name: renderMessage
methods.description: Formats a log message by combining message and metadata.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Writes a log message to a file if enabled, including metadata.
